title: Gift orders
summary: Create a gift, receiver shop, admin offers. Can replace view.cart for the receiver. Permission gift.

items.description: scope public path /gift (giver and receiver routers)
scope admin path /gift, nav Gift, permission gift
Receiver cart can replace the shop cart surface while a lock is on
Gift bag on the quote and order

blocks.text: Disable to hide the Offer menu and gift APIs. Do not import gift http/ from another plugin.

Bundled path: tuucho-config/plugins/tuucho-commerce-gift/ (public config.json, gitignored config.private.json, committed config.private.example.json). Merge matches kernel JSON (common then env, private or example). Boot does not overwrite Admin values. First launch loads files once when settings are still empty. Edit in Admin → Plugins → Configure, or Update from files / Import / Export there. Admin → Plugins Update all / Import all / Export all uses the same files (schema plugins only; no extra register).

items.description: number — public. Days a receiver link stays valid before the giver must send a new one.
number — public. Furthest a giver may extend a promise. Raise only if you allow longer gifts.
number — public. Hours a receiver PIN session stays unlocked on that browser.
number — public. Days reserved stock is held after the receiver picks, until the giver pays.
number — public. Days the giver has to pay after the receiver chose. After that the hold is released.
number — public. Days a finished gift stays visible in history before it is hidden.
number — public. Days after terminal before cron deletes leftover gift rows. Keep aligned with legal retention.
string — public. How early the receiver is reminded to pick (for example 3d) before the select window ends.
string — public. How early the giver is reminded a stock hold will expire.
string — public. How early the giver is reminded to pay before the pay window ends.
number — public. Lowest gift budget the giver may set, in euros.
number — public. Highest gift budget for products, in euros.
number — public. Highest extra budget for accessories, in euros.
number — public. How many unfinished gifts one giver may have at once.
string — public. Free guesses then lock (for example 5:8). Raise only if receivers struggle on mobile.
string — public. JSONL path for the gift reminder cron. Change only if you relocated kernel logs.
string — public. JSONL path for the gift purge cron.
string — public. Window:max for PIN attempts (for example 60s:20).
string — public. Window:max for gift-create mails (for example 15m:10).
string — public. Window:max for share-card edits (for example 15m:5).
string — public. Window:max for share-card downloads (for example 15m:5).
string — public. Window:max for share-card emails (for example 15m:5).
